Questions, corrections, reproducibility reports, proposals, and contributions
are welcome.

| What you want to do | Recommended route |
|---|---|
| Correct a claim, equation, result, file, or page | [Open the correction form](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/issues/new?template=correction.yml) |
| Propose a new check, experiment, or HOPE-R extension | [Open the proposal form](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/issues/new?template=proposal.yml) |
| Submit a focused implementation or documentation change | [Read the contribution guide](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) |
| Share private or sensitive context | [Email Bashar](mailto:elnashefb@gmail.com) |

::: {.callout-note}
## Email

Contact [Bashar Elnashef](mailto:elnashefb@gmail.com) at
[`elnashefb@gmail.com`](mailto:elnashefb@gmail.com).
:::

## Corrections and reproducible problems

For a public, reproducible problem, open a
[focused correction report](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/issues/new?template=correction.yml).
Include the affected part, equation, claim, result, or URL; what you observed;
what you expected; and the smallest supporting example or source.

If the report contains private context or you are unsure whether it should be
public, use email first. Do not send credentials, confidential employer
information, or private datasets.

## Proposals and extensions

Ideas for new checks, stronger experiments, alternative derivations, or
extensions to HOPE-R can begin by email or through the
[proposal form](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/issues/new?template=proposal.yml).
For a substantial code change, discussing the scope first helps keep the
paper-literal audit separate from proposed repairs.

## Code and documentation contributions

Pull requests are welcome for focused changes to code, tests, documentation,
or figures. Read the
[current contribution guide](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for the test commands, evidence requirements, and licensing boundaries.
